[!symlink] skip 'fake GOROOT needs symlinks'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# A .lgo package shipped in the toolchain tree under src/logos/ (outside
# the fixed rt/arena/sync set) must be materialized into the ejected
# support module under rt/logos/, transitively, so the ejected tree
# builds with plain Go. The test installs fixture packages in a private
# toolchain root inside $WORK and selects it with GOROOT.
# Nothing is written into the real GOROOT.
go run mkgoroot.go $TESTGO_GOROOT $WORK/fakegoroot dep
env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^ejecttestdep ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos run -tags pr270variant .
stdout '^ejecttestleaf ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-variant.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestdep/ejecttestdep.go
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/ejecttestdep
! grep '^//go:build' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestdep/ejecttestdep.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestdep/variant.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestleaf/ejecttestleaf.go

env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
go run -tags pr270variant .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-variant.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run -tags pr270variant .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-variant.txt

# logos/json mirrors the path of the runtime package logos/rt/json. Its
# lowered copy lands in its own directory, so it neither replaces nor
# joins the runtime package.
cd ../../j
logos run .
stdout '^2 7 9$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-json.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/json/diagnostics.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/json/doc.go
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/json/diagnostics.go
grep 'runtime support package' out/_logos_deps/rt/json/doc.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-json.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-json.txt

# A shipped .lgo package outside the fixed set is also materialized from
# the real toolchain, with no fixture GOROOT. logos/expect lands under
# rt/logos/ like every other non-runtime toolchain package.
cd ../../r
logos run .
stdout '^count: 42$'
stdout 'expect: values differ'
cp stdout $WORK/native-real.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/expect/expect.go
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/expect
! exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/expect/expect_test.go
! grep '^//go:build' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/expect/expect.go
grep 'gosuda/loGos/rt/logos/expect' out/main.go
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-real.txt

-- mkgoroot.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkgoroot: %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func link(oldname, newname string) {
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(newname), 0777), "mkdir "+filepath.Dir(newname))
	must(os.Symlink(oldname, newname), "symlink "+newname)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkgoroot <realGOROOT> <fakeRoot> <fixtures>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	real, fake, fixtures := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3]

	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), 0777), "mkdir fake src/logos")

	ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(real, "src"))
	must(err, "read real src")
	for _, e := range ents {
		if e.Name() == "logos" {
			continue
		}
		link(filepath.Join(real, "src", e.Name()), filepath.Join(fake, "src", e.Name()))
	}

	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(filepath.Join(real, "src", "logos"))), "copy support sources")
	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(fixtures)), "install fixture packages")

	// The package index distinguishes .lgo-only standard packages, but
	// bypasses files with recent mtimes. Age only the private copies.
	old := time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)
	must(filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), func(name string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return err
		}
		return os.Chtimes(name, old, old)
	}), "age copied support and fixture files")

	link(filepath.Join(real, "pkg"), filepath.Join(fake, "pkg"))
	link(filepath.Join(real, "VERSION"), filepath.Join(fake, "VERSION"))
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "go.env")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "go.env"), filepath.Join(fake, "go.env"))
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "lib")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "lib"), filepath.Join(fake, "lib"))
	}
}

-- dep/ejecttestdep/ejecttestdep.lgo --
package ejecttestdep

// Hello reports that the toolchain package lowered and ran.
func Hello() string {
	return value()
}

-- dep/ejecttestdep/value.lgo --
//go:build !pr270variant

package ejecttestdep

func value() string { return "ejecttestdep ok" }

-- dep/ejecttestdep/variant.lgo --
//go:build pr270variant

package ejecttestdep

import "logos/ejecttestleaf"

func value() string { return ejecttestleaf.Value() }

-- dep/ejecttestleaf/ejecttestleaf.lgo --
package ejecttestleaf

func Value() string { return "ejecttestleaf ok" }

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/gorootdep

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/ejecttestdep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(ejecttestdep.Hello())
}

-- j/go.mod --
module example.com/gorootjson

go 1.27

-- j/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	ljson "logos/json"
	_ "logos/rt/json"
)

func main() {
	d := ljson.DiagnosticsFor([]byte("{\n  \"a\": x}"), 9)
	fmt.Println(d.Line, d.Column, d.Offset)
}

-- r/go.mod --
module example.com/gorootdep

go 1.27

-- r/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/expect"
)
func main() {
	fmt.Println(expect.FieldText("count", 42))
	rep := &depReporter{}
	expect.Equal(rep, depProbe{Count: 1}, depProbe{Count: 2})
	if !rep.failed {
		fmt.Println("equal-specialization: not exercised")
	}
}

type depProbe struct {
	Count int
}

type depReporter struct {
	failed bool
}

func (r *depReporter) Helper() {}

func (r *depReporter) Errorf(format string, args ...any) {
	r.failed = true
	fmt.Printf(format, args...)
}
